# AgenticOS

> AgenticOS is open-source (Apache-2.0), self-hosted software for a company's AI agents: "AI teammates" that work with files, run code in a sandbox, browse the web and use the company's own tools and knowledge. Teams build and publish agents in a browser; engineers extend them in typed Python. It runs on the company's own infrastructure with Docker Compose and is built on Pydantic AI by Vstorm.

Key facts (release 1.1.1):

- Licence: Apache-2.0. Commercial use, modification and private deployment are allowed. There is no seat or credit fee; you pay for your infrastructure and the model usage you choose.
- Where it runs: your own servers (Docker Compose). A host with 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM runs it. It can run fully local with Ollama or vLLM.
- Models: 27 providers, hosted (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral and others), through your cloud contract (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) or local.
- Capabilities: 26 built in, switched on per agent: knowledge search with citations (RAG), skills, context, memory, web search, a real web browser the user can take over, a code sandbox with files and a shell, charts, image generation, apps (published pages with a stable link and versions), subagents, planning, guardrails that redact secrets and personal data.
- Integrations: 4,700+ MCP servers in the gallery; document sync from Google Drive, S3/MinIO, Git, websites, SharePoint and OneDrive.
- Surfaces: one agent answers in web chat, a website widget, a hosted page, the HTTP API, a WebSocket, Slack, Mattermost and Telegram.
- Control: roles and department groups, company sign-in (OIDC SSO, LDAP, Kerberos), monthly budgets checked before each model call, approvals for sensitive tools, a hash-chained audit log, an envelope-encrypted credential vault, sandboxed code execution. Native MFA, SAML and SCIM are not available yet; MFA comes from the identity provider.
- Skills and context: a team's procedures become skills and its standing facts (thresholds, owners, policies) become context; every agent reads both, so a rule changed once changes every agent that uses it.
- Agents are versioned specs that export to YAML.
- AgenticOS is also an MCP server: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can run its agents and read runs.
- Install: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vstorm-co/agenticos/main/scripts/quickstart.sh | bash

Who makes it: Vstorm (https://vstorm.co), an agentic AI engineering company from Wrocław, Poland. Vstorm is an official Pydantic implementation partner, an OpenAI Select Partner, an Anthropic Claude Certified Services Partner and a member of the Agentic AI Foundation.

Product or service: both. AgenticOS is open-source software anyone can run; Vstorm also rolls it out for companies in three phases (Foundation, Engineering, Handover) with forward-deployed engineers and a transformation manager. You pay for implementation and tailoring: no subscription, no seat count, no long-term commitment. Ownership covers all five layers: process logic, data, models, codebase and infrastructure.
